notes: Commit 7432f3b fixes the two worst problems from the last review. The band's own tour now reads in fans and euros on the dashboard stats, the show cards and the show page (320 fans, €6,400 held, €3,120 your share), with one line explaining the 1-in-20 sample and the compressed clock. Clicking one of the band's own shows now opens a page named after its city, venue and day, with a 'Your show' card instead of a buy box. The stepper reads Route approved → Venues signed → On sale → Confirmed → Paid out without the duplicate stat. Activity lines lead with the city. Phone feeds say 'Loading…' instead of 'nothing happened'. 'New tour' is an outline button while a tour sells, and the wizard warns that a second booking replaces the dashboard view. Wallet details sit below the tour, and phone Venues shows two rooms per city (10,448 px instead of 15,027 px). The public screen, the single 'Create your first tour' button and the four-question wizard with preview and money remain good. Below 8.5, because the translation into band units stops halfway, so the screens still contradict each other: the Hamburg card says '240 of 400 fans' and then 'Confirmed with 12 sold'. The live feed still speaks in sample tickets and SOL ('Threshold met (12/20)', 'A fan got 0.0057 SOL back'). The show page shows 'Tickets (0)' under '80 / 400 fans', with SOL amounts and 'held in escrow'. Band record counts tickets and 'Gross settled' in SOL. The desktop booked dashboard (7-booked-dashboard.png) still says 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet' next to a confirmed show with 240 fans. The wizard promises rooms of 1,600 and a full house for your draw, but the booking caps every show at 40 sample tickets (800 fans), so a band that brings 2,500 sees '… of 800 fans' after booking. On a phone the nav is still a cut-off scroller that hides Band record and Activity. The wizard and own-show pages were never captured at 390 px. Older friction is untouched: the double-tap on Book, the price input that clamps on every keystroke, the Berlin default, the planner overwriting a sketch with no undo, Approvals offering 'Create a tour' to a band whose tour is running, the itinerary and Shows grid repeating each other, raw seconds in Approvals, and chain words on registration, band record and show page.
issues: packages/web/src/components/ShowCard.tsx:59 + packages/web/src/lib/health.ts:54,60,68: in band units only the onSale line is translated; confirmed and cancelled fall back to v.status in sample tickets, so the Hamburg card reads '240 of 400 fans' and then 'Confirmed with 12 sold; still selling' (7-booked-dashboard.png, phone-booked-dashboard.png), and a cancelled show will say 'Missed 10 by the deadline'. Fix: give showView a units formatter (fans or tickets) and build every status line through it, so that it reads 'Going ahead with 240 fans; still selling'.

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:22,106 vs book.ts:51-61 and app/tour/new/page.tsx:223: the preview says 'room 1,600' and works out the full house from min(draw, room). The booking then caps every show at MAX_TICKETS=40, which is 800 fans, so for a draw of 1,000 or more the dashboard shows a smaller house ('… of 800 fans') than the band approved, and the € promise no longer matches. Fix: compute planMoney and the preview's 'room' line from the same capped capacity the booking will write ('sells up to 800 tickets in this demo'), or raise the cap for those draws.

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:115-122 (and Feed.tsx:12-16): the band's activity lines still use chain units and words: 'Proposed Leipzig: 20 tickets, 50% threshold', 'A fan bought 1 ticket (4 sold so far)', 'Threshold met (12/20): show confirmed', 'A fan got 0.0057 SOL back', 'Paid out 0.11 SOL: band …'. This contradicts the euros and fans on the cards above it. Fix: pass the band-units flag into describe() and say 'Hamburg: 20 more fans (240 of 400)', 'Hamburg is going ahead', 'A fan got €20 back', 'Paid out €4,800: you €3,120, venue €1,680'.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:405 + components/Feed.tsx:118-121: once events load empty (a public RPC that drops signatures, or the bot's fake devnet), the dashboard still prints 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet.' next to 320 fans and a confirmed show (7-booked-dashboard.png). Fix: derive the empty text from the tour (when anything is sold, say 'Ticket sales are coming in; the details appear here shortly'), or build feed lines from the show accounts' own counters when no events come back.

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:1086-1104 + components/Connect.tsx:117-119: at 390 px the nav is still a horizontal scroller cut off at 'Route plan' (every phone-*.png). Band record and Activity, which the band asked for, stay off-screen, and gated phone pages still show the 'Greenroom' brand twice. Fix: a bottom tab bar (Home, Venues, Activity, Record; Planner and Approvals reached from Home), and hide .welcome .brand under 896 px.

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:173-180,262-288,135-137,203: the band's show page still shows 'Deadline 29m 50s' and 'Show date 59m 50s' as bare countdowns. It shows 'Tickets (0)' under '80 / 400 fans', because getProgramAccounts is refused on public RPCs, with an empty table and no empty state. Rows read in SOL with wallet prefixes and 'held in escrow'. 'Share this page' has no share or copy button. Fix: 'Ticket sales close in 30 min (demo time)' and 'Show in 1 h', hide the ticket table for the band (or say 'Fan list unavailable on public devnet'), use euros and 'held until the show', and add a 'Copy fan link' button.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:85-90 + lib/book.ts:156-175: busy is still set only when bookTour first calls onStatus, after the dynamic import, the profile fetch and the instruction builds, so 'Book this tour' stays live for a second or more and a double tap starts two bookings. Fix: setBusy('Preparing…') as the first line of book().

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:352-378: after booking, the same three shows appear in a stepper, five stat tiles, the itinerary with badges and again as a Shows grid. On a phone the route starts about 800 px down and the Shows grid repeats it below (phone-booked-dashboard.png). Fix: keep one summary line plus the itinerary, put each stop's progress bar inline and open the card on tap, and drop the separate Shows grid.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:163: the custom price still clamps on every keystroke (Number('') || 1), so deleting '20' to type '35' gives 1 and then 13. Fix: keep the raw string in state and clamp on blur or on Plan my tour.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:115-121,459 + components/WalletPanel.tsx:86-94: on the no-tour screen (2-connected.png) the chain strip (wallet address, '1.5 SOL devnet', 'Settled shows', 'Tickets you hold') still sits above the band name, and the copy still says 'Your band is on-chain.' Fix: render the panel below the CTA there too (or in the wallet button's menu), drop 'Tickets you hold' from the band view, and write 'You're set up. Time for the first tour.'

packages/web/src/app/approvals/page.tsx:305 + components/Shell.tsx:19: a wizard band whose tour is running gets 'Create a tour' as the only action on Approvals, a permanent empty nav item. Fix: link 'Follow your tour' when a live tour exists, and hide Approvals from the nav for wizard-booked tours unless something is pending.

packages/web/src/app/planner/page.tsx:113-118: 'Open in route planner →' (?from=tour) still overwrites the band's saved sketch through savePlan(tourIds), and the planner re-schedules with its own rest rule, so the dates differ from the dashboard. 'Load my tour' and 'Clear' wipe the plan with no undo. Phone planner still has an empty ~120 px band under the nav (phone-planner.png). Fix: keep the tour's real days, offer an undo toast, and find what stretches the header row at 390 px.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:271 + app/tour/new/page.tsx:129-134 + lib/chain-live.ts:69: booking a second tour while one sells is now warned about, but the running tour still disappears from the dashboard (only toursCreated-1 is read), and there is no way back to it. Fix: list earlier tours under the current one ('Past and running tours'), and confirm on New tour while shows are selling.

packages/web/src/app/band/page.tsx:72-90 + components/Connect.tsx:196,205-206 + components/Approvals.tsx:390 + app/approvals/page.tsx:324: chain words and raw units remain on band-facing screens. Band record: 'Tickets sold' (sample count), 'Gross settled' in SOL, 'Settled shows', 'profile ↗'. Registration: 'rent', and errors shown raw. Approvals: 'lapses in about 287s', 'Nothing goes on-chain'. Fix: fans and euros on the record, 'Played shows', 'deposit', pass registration errors through bookingErrorText, and '~5 min'.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:20,200-228: every band still starts in Berlin, and the route is take-it-or-leave-it. In 4-route-preview.png Berlin is followed by '4 days off' before a 179 km drive, with no explanation and no way to drop a stop or pull a date in. Fix: remember the last start city (or ask for a home city at registration), say why a gap exists ('no free room in Leipzig before Nov 8'), and allow per-stop toggles like the Approvals route card.

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:229 + phone-venues.png: phone Venues is shorter (10,448 px) but still one long list of every city under two filter toolbars, and 'No venues match these filters' offers no reset. Fix: collapse each city to one summary row that opens on tap, put the filters behind a single 'Filter' button on phones, and add 'Clear filters' to the empty state.

qa/src/ui-bot.ts:427-434: the phone sweep still captures /tour/new, /band, /feed and /approvals without a wallet, so phone-tour-new.png, phone-band.png, phone-feed.png and phone-approvals.png are all the connect screen. The wizard, the route preview and the band's show page at 390 px are never checked. Fix: run the phone sweep with the connected fake band (as phone-booked-dashboard already does), and add the wizard preview and /show to it.
